headline: 2K launches new studio to build its ‘next blockbuster sports franchise’
summary: 2K establishes Small Axe Studios to develop a new blockbuster sports franchise. The new AAA studio's first project is speculated to be a soccer game. This move aims to expand 2K's sports gaming portfolio.

headline: Ford’s $28,000 Fathom EV nears production after $2 billion factory overhaul
summary: Ford's Fathom EV is slated for production in Q1 2027 at its revamped Louisville plant. The automaker invested $2 billion in facility upgrades for EV manufacturing. Pre-tooling is already underway, with prototypes coming first.

headline: Meta adds AI screening to detect WhatsApp scams
summary: WhatsApp is introducing an optional Scam Alert feature using on-device AI. The feature detects and warns users about suspicious messages in chats. It's rolling out in a limited beta to enhance user security.

headline: The Corvette Grand Sport X delivers Porsche 911 performance for a fraction of the price
summary: The 2027 Corvette Grand Sport X promises Porsche 911-level performance. It offers a premium driving experience at a significantly lower cost. A recent test drive navigated challenging weather conditions.

headline: The 10 Most Expensive MTG Cards in The Hobbit Set
summary: Discover the top 10 most valuable Magic: The Gathering cards from The Hobbit set. This guide details which cards command the highest prices. It's a must-read for collectors and investors in MTG.

headline: 'Halo Studios Went Too Far in the Wrong Direction' — Co-Creator of Halo Hits Out at the Main Menu Ring in Xbox's New Remake
summary: A Halo co-creator criticizes Xbox's new Combat Evolved remake. Specific complaints include the main menu's 'ring' design. Disappointment was also expressed over the absence of PvP modes.

headline: Krispy Kreme Is Getting 6 New Pokémon-Themed Donuts
summary: Krispy Kreme announces a new collection of six Pokémon-themed doughnuts. These limited-edition treats will be available starting August 18th. Fans can look forward to unique designs inspired by the franchise.

headline: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros Gameplay Reveal Shows Lannister Troops Getting Cooked by a Fire-Breathing Dragon, With a Longer Look Due Later This Month
summary: First gameplay footage for Game of Thrones: War for Westeros has been released. The real-time strategy game lets players conquer the Seven Kingdoms. A longer look at the gameplay is scheduled for later this month.

headline: Five key takeaways from results day 2026
summary: Top grades and university attendance are on the rise for 2026. Technical subjects are also growing in popularity among students. The report highlights significant trends from the year's academic results.

headline: Son pays tribute to dad, 102, who died after allegedly being assaulted in pub
summary: A 102-year-old man, Phillip Ormerod, has died following an alleged pub assault. His son shared a heartfelt tribute to his father. Police have confirmed the death and launched an investigation.

headline: Water bills set to rise for many after firms permitted extra funding
summary: Ofwat has provisionally allowed 13 water companies to raise customer charges. The increase will fund essential investments in infrastructure. Many households can expect higher water bills.

headline: The key signs you may have damaged your eyes by looking at the eclipse
summary: Learn the crucial signs of eye damage from viewing an eclipse unprotected. Blurred vision is a primary indicator of potential harm. The article stresses the importance of using certified eclipse glasses.
